limitations: Offline implementation evidence only. Physical comparison is a separate record.

Single implementation. Resource differences include optimisation and placement effects, not isolated controller area.
FPGA utilisation does not directly give physical silicon area.
32 existing DSP pipeline advisories remain. No severity waivers.
Verified Mac copies are available. Shared backup remains pending.
